title: Delete a specific keychain
summary: Remove a specific keychain file from your Mac. Be careful, as this permanently deletes all credentials stored in that keychain.

steps.explain: Delete the keychain file at the specified path.

placeholders.name: KEYCHAIN_PATH
placeholders.description: The full path to the keychain file you want to delete.

rollback.explain: There is no command to restore a deleted keychain. You must have a backup of the keychain file to restore it.

warnings: Deleting a keychain permanently removes all passwords and certificates stored within it. Ensure you have a backup if needed.
